retry.\n888\tfunc (h *Handler) doRequestWithRetry(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, reqBody []byte, p provider.Provider) (*http.Response, error) {\n889\t\tmaxRetries := 3\n890\t\tbaseDelay := 500 * time.Millisecond\n891\t\n892\t\tvar lastErr error\n893\t\tfor attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {\n894\t\t\t// Create fresh request for each attempt with context\n895\t\t\tupstreamReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(context.Background(), http.MethodPost, p.GetEndpointURL(), bytes.NewReader(reqBody))\n896\t\t\tif err != nil {\n897\t\t\t\treturn nil, p.GetHeaders(h.cfg.GetAPIKey()) {\n902\t\t\t\tfor _, v := range values {\n903\t\t\t\t\tupstreamReq.Header.Add(key, v)\n904\t\t\t\t}\n905\t\t\t}\n906\t\n907\t\t\tresp, err := h.client.Do(upstreamReq)\n908\t\t\tif err == nil {\n909\t\t\t\t// Check if we should retry based on status code\n910\t\t\t\tif resp.StatusCode < 500 || resp.StatusCode == 529 { // Don't retry 5xx except overload\n911\t\t\t\t\treturn resp, nil\n912\t\t\t\t}\n913\t\t\t\t// Close response for retry\n914\t\t\t\tresp.Body.Close()\n915\t\t\t\tlastErr = fmt.Errorf(\"upstream returned %d\", resp.StatusCode)\n916\t\t\t} else {\n917\t\t\t\tlastErr = err\n918\t\t\t}\n919\t\n920\t\t\t// Don't retry on last attempt\n921\t\t\tif attempt < maxRetries-1 {\n922\t\t\t\tdelay := baseDelay * time.Duration(1<<attempt) // Exponential backoff\n923\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Retry %d/%d after %v: %v\", attempt+1, maxRetries, delay, lastErr)\n924\t\n925\t\t\t\tselect {\n926\t\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n927\t\t\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"context canceled\")\n928\t\t\t\tcase <-time.After(delay):\n929\t\t\t\t}\n930\t\t\t}\n931\t\t}\n932\t\n933\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"max retries exceeded: %w\", lastErr)\n934\t}\n935\t\n936\t// getFallbackProvider returns the appropriate fallback provider and model for the given request model.\n937\t// It checks tier-specific fallbacks first, provider.NewCustomProvider(cfg.CustomBaseURL), nil\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"unsupported provider: %s\", cfg.Provider)\n\t}\n}\n\n// createTierProvider creates a provider from a tier configuration.\nfunc createTierProvider(tierCfg *config.TierConfig) (provider.Provider, error) {\n\tbaseURL := tierCfg.BaseURL\n\tswitch tierCfg.Provider {\n\tcase config.ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\tif baseURL == \"\" {\n\t\t\tbaseURL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn provider.NewOpenAIProviderWithKey(baseURL, tierCfg.APIKey), nil\n\tcase config.ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\tif baseURL {\n\t\t\tbaseURL = \"http://localhost:11434\"\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn provider.NewOllamaProviderWithKey(baseURL, tierCfg.APIKey), nil\n\tcase config.ProviderGemini:\n\t\tif baseURL == \"\" {\n\t\t\tbaseURL {\n\t\t\tbaseURL = \"https://api.deepseek.com\"\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn provider.NewDeepSeekProviderWithURL(baseURL, tierCfg.APIKey), nil\n\tcase config.ProviderGrok:\n\t\tif baseURL == \"\" {\n\t\t\tbaseURL = \"https://api.x.ai\"\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn provider.NewGrokProviderWithURL(baseURL, tierCfg.APIKey), nil\n\tcase config.ProviderQwen:\n\t\tif baseURL == \"\" {\n\t\t\tbaseURL = \"https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode\"\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn provider.NewQwenProviderWithURL(baseURL, tierCfg.APIKey), nil\n\tcase config.ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\tif baseURL == \"\" provider.NewCustomProviderWithKey(baseURL, tierCfg.APIKey), nil\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"unsupported tier provider: %s\", tierCfg.Provider)\n\t}\n}\n\n// HandleMessages handles POST /v1/messages requests.\nfunc (h *Handler) HandleMessages(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tstart := time.Now()\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.TotalRequests, 1)\n\n\t// Parse and validate request\n\tanthropicReq, reqErr := h.parseAndValidateRequest(r)\n\tif reqErr != nil {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, reqErr.statusCode, reqErr.errType, reqErr.message)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdefer r.Body.Close()\n\n\t// Check cache for non-streaming requests\n\tcacheKey, cacheable := h.checkCache(w, anthropicReq)\n\tif cacheKey == \"HIT\" {\n\t\treturn // Response already sent from cache\n\t}\n\n\t// Check prompt cache (prefix-based matching for cache_control-marked requests)\n\tif h.promptCache != nil && !anthropicReq.Stream {\n\t\tpromptKey, promptTokens, promptOK := cache.GeneratePromptCacheKey(anthropicReq)\n\t\tif promptOK {\n\t\t\tif cachedResp, _, found := h.promptCache.Get(promptKey); found {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Prompt cache HIT (prefix match, ~%d tokens saved)\", promptTokens)\n\t\t\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\t\t\t\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t\t\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Cache\", \"HIT\")\n\t\t\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Prompt-Cache\", \"HIT\")\n\t\t\t\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(cachedResp)\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Store prompt cache context for later use when storing the response\n\tif h.promptCache != nil && cacheKey != \"\" && cacheable {\n\t\tif pk, pt, pok := cache.GeneratePromptCacheKey(anthropicReq); pok {\n\t\t\th.promptCachePending.Store(cacheKey, promptCacheCtx{key: pk, tokens: pt})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Select provider and resolve target model\n\tselectedProvider, targetModel := h.selectProviderAndModel(anthropicReq)\n\n\t// Determine compaction context (previous_response_id for Responses API sessions).\n\tvar previousResponseID, sessionKey string\n\tvar newMessagesOffset int\n\tif h.sessionTracker != nil && selectedProvider.RequiresTransformation() {\n\t\tif translator.GetEndpointType(targetModel) == translator.EndpointResponses {\n\t\t\tsessionKey = translator.SessionKey(anthropicReq)\n\t\t\tif entry, ok := h.sessionTracker.Get(sessionKey); ok && entry.MessageCount < len(anthropicReq.Messages) {\n\t\t\t\tpreviousResponseID = entry.ResponseID\n\t\t\t\tnewMessagesOffset = entry.MessageCount\n\t\t\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.CompactionHits, 1)\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Compaction: continuing session %s..., previous_response_id=%s (offset=%d)\",\n\t\t\t\t\tsessionKey[:8], previousResponseID, newMessagesOffset)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.CompactionMisses, 1)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Check circuit breaker\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil && !h.circuitBreaker.Allow() {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Circuit breaker open - rejecting request\")\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Circuit-Breaker\", \"open\")\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, \"overloaded_error\", \"Service temporarily unavailable - circuit breaker open\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Check if this provider requires transformation (passthrough mode for Anthropic)\n\tif !selectedProvider.RequiresTransformation() {\n\t\th.handlePassthroughRequest(w, r, anthropicReq, selectedProvider, start, cacheKey, cacheable)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Transform and execute request\n\tresp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, usedFallback, execErr := h.transformAndExecute(r.Context(), anthropicReq, selectedProvider, targetModel, previousResponseID, newMessagesOffset)\n\tif execErr != nil {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error making upstream request: %v\", execErr)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusBadGateway, \"api_error\", \"Error connecting to upstream provider\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdefer resp.Body.Close()\n\n\t// Handle upstream errors\n\tif resp.StatusCode >= 400 {\n\t\th.handleUpstreamError(w, resp)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Record success\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordSuccess()\n\t}\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.TotalLatencyMs, time.Since(start).Milliseconds())\n\n\t// Set response headers\n\tif usedFallback {\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Fallback\", \"true\")\n\t}\n\tif useResponsesAPI {\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Responses-API\", \"true\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Handle streaming vs non-streaming response\n\th.handleResponse(w, resp, anthropicReq.Stream, useResponsesAPI, targetModel, cacheKey, cacheable, sessionKey, len(anthropicReq.Messages))\n}\n\n// requestError represents a request validation error with HTTP status info.\ntype requestError struct {\n\tstatusCode int\n\terrType    string\n\tmessage    string\n}\n\n// parseAndValidateRequest parses and validates an incoming Anthropic request.\nfunc (h *Handler) parseAndValidateRequest(r *http.Request) (*models.AnthropicRequest, *requestError) {\n\t// Only accept POST\n\tif r.Method != http.MethodPost {\n\t\treturn nil, &requestError{\n\t\t\tstatusCode: http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,\n\t\t\terrType:    \"invalid_request_error\",\n\t\t\tmessage:    \"Method not allowed\",\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Parse request body\n\tvar anthropicReq models.AnthropicRequest\n\tif err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&anthropicReq); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error parsing request: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, &requestError{\n\t\t\tstatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest,\n\t\t\terrType:    \"invalid_request_error\",\n\t\t\tmessage:    fmt.Sprintf(\"Invalid request body: %v. Expected Anthropic Messages API format with 'model', 'messages', and optionally 'stream', 'tools', etc.\", err),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Validate required fields\n\tif err := h.validateRequest(&anthropicReq); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Track request types\n\tif anthropicReq.Stream {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.StreamRequests, 1)\n\t}\n\tif len(anthropicReq.Tools) > 0 {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ToolCallRequests, 1)\n\t}\n\n\t// Resolve model alias if configured\n\toriginalModel := anthropicReq.Model\n\tanthropicReq.Model = h.cfg.ResolveAlias(anthropicReq.Model)\n\tif anthropicReq.Model != originalModel {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Resolved model alias: %s -> %s\", originalModel, anthropicReq.Model)\n\t}\n\n\t// Debug logging for incoming request (secrets are masked)\n\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\tdebugJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(anthropicReq, \"\", \"  \")\n\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(debugJSON)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Incoming Anthropic request:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"INCOMING\", \"/v1/messages\", maskedJSON)\n\t}\n\n\treturn &anthropicReq, nil\n}\n\n// validateRequest validates required fields in the Anthropic request.\nfunc (h *Handler) validateRequest(req *models.AnthropicRequest) *requestError {\n\tif req.Model == \"\" {\n\t\treturn &requestError{\n\t\t\tstatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest,\n\t\t\terrType:    \"invalid_request_error\",\n\t\t\tmessage:    \"Missing required field: 'model'\",\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(req.Messages) == 0 {\n\t\treturn &requestError{\n\t\t\tstatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest,\n\t\t\terrType:    \"invalid_request_error\",\n\t\t\tmessage:    \"Missing required field: 'messages'\",\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// checkCache checks if the request is in cache and returns cache key/status.\n// Returns \"HIT\" as cacheKey if response was served from cache.\nfunc (h *Handler) checkCache(w http.ResponseWriter, req *models.AnthropicRequest) (string, bool) {\n\tif h.cache == nil || req.Stream {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tcacheKey, cacheable := GenerateCacheKey(req)\n\tif !cacheable {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tif cachedResp, found := h.cache.Get(cacheKey); found {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Cache HIT for request\")\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Cache\", \"HIT\")\n\t\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(cachedResp)\n\t\treturn \"HIT\", true\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Cache MISS for request\")\n\treturn cacheKey, cacheable\n}\n\n// promptCacheCtx holds prompt cache key and token estimate for a request.\ntype promptCacheCtx struct {\n\tkey    string\n\ttokens int\n}\n\n// tryStorePromptCache stores a response in the prompt cache if a pending context exists.\n// The cacheKey parameter is the regular cache key used to look up the prompt cache context.\nfunc (h *Handler) tryStorePromptCache(cacheKey string, resp *models.AnthropicResponse) {\n\tif h.promptCache == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif val, ok := h.promptCachePending.LoadAndDelete(cacheKey); ok {\n\t\tctx := val.(promptCacheCtx)\n\t\th.promptCache.Set(ctx.key, resp, ctx.tokens)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Response stored in prompt cache (prefix ~%d tokens)\", ctx.tokens)\n\t}\n}\n\n// selectProviderAndModel selects the appropriate provider and target model.\nfunc (h *Handler) selectProviderAndModel(req *models.AnthropicRequest) (provider.Provider, string) {\n\tselectedProvider := h.provider\n\ttierCfg := h.cfg.GetTierConfig(req.Model)\n\tvar targetModel string\n\n\tif tierCfg != nil {\n\t\ttier := config.GetModelTier(req.Model)\n\t\tif tierProvider, ok := h.tierProviders[tier]; ok {\n\t\t\tselectedProvider = tierProvider\n\t\t\ttargetModel = tierCfg.Model\n\t\t\tif targetModel == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\ttargetModel = h.cfg.MapModel(req.Model)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Multi-provider routing: %s -> %s via %s\", req.Model, targetModel, tierCfg.Provider)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\ttargetModel = h.cfg.MapModel(req.Model)\n\t\t\ttargetModel = selectedProvider.TransformModelID(targetModel)\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\ttargetModel = h.cfg.MapModel(req.Model)\n\t\ttargetModel = selectedProvider.TransformModelID(targetModel)\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Request: %s -> %s (streaming: %v, provider: %s, passthrough: %v)\",\n\t\treq.Model, targetModel, req.Stream, selectedProvider.Name(), !selectedProvider.RequiresTransformation())\n\n\treturn selectedProvider, targetModel\n}\n\n// transformAndExecute transforms the request and executes it against the provider.\nfunc (h *Handler) transformAndExecute(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, req *models.AnthropicRequest, selectedProvider provider.Provider, targetModel, previousResponseID string, newMessagesOffset int) (*http.Response, string, bool, bool, error) {\n\tendpointType := translator.GetEndpointType(targetModel)\n\tuseResponsesAPI := endpointType == translator.EndpointResponses\n\n\t// Set target model on provider for endpoint URL selection\n\tif openaiProvider, ok := selectedProvider.(*provider.OpenAIProvider); ok {\n\t\topenaiProvider.SetTargetModel(targetModel)\n\t}\n\n\t// Transform request\n\treqBody, err := h.transformRequest(req, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, previousResponseID, newMessagesOffset)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, false, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Execute request\n\tresp, err := h.doRequestWithRetry(ctx, reqBody, selectedProvider)\n\tusedFallback := false\n\n\t// Check if we should try fallback\n\tif err != nil || (resp != nil && resp.StatusCode >= 500) {\n\t\tresp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, usedFallback, err = h.tryFallback(ctx, req, resp, targetModel, err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn resp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, usedFallback, err\n}\n\n// transformRequest transforms an Anthropic request to the appropriate format.\n// previousResponseID and newMessagesOffset are used for Responses API compaction:\n// when set, only the messages after newMessagesOffset are sent (the rest are\n// captured by the previous_response_id chain).\nfunc (h *Handler) transformRequest(req *models.AnthropicRequest, targetModel string, useResponsesAPI bool, previousResponseID string, newMessagesOffset int) ([]byte, error) {\n\tif useResponsesAPI {\n\t\t// Apply compaction: trim messages to only the new ones when continuing a session.\n\t\treqToTransform := req\n\t\tif previousResponseID != \"\" {\n\t\t\tif newMessages := translator.TrimMessagesForCompaction(req.Messages, newMessagesOffset); newMessages != nil {\n\t\t\t\ttrimmed := *req\n\t\t\t\ttrimmed.Messages = newMessages\n\t\t\t\treqToTransform = &trimmed\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tresponsesReq, err := translator.TransformRequestToResponses(reqToTransform, targetModel, previousResponseID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error transforming request to Responses API: %v\", err)\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treqBody, err := json.Marshal(responsesReq)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error marshaling Responses request: %v\", err)\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\t\tdebugJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(responsesReq, \"\", \"  \")\n\t\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(debugJSON)\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Outgoing OpenAI Responses API request:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"OUTGOING\", \"/v1/responses\", maskedJSON)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Using Responses API for model: %s\", targetModel)\n\t\treturn reqBody, nil\n\t}\n\n\topenAIReq, err := translator.TransformRequest(req, targetModel)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error transforming request: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\treqBody, err := json.Marshal(openAIReq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error marshaling request: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\tdebugJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(openAIReq, \"\", \"  \")\n\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(debugJSON)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Outgoing OpenAI Chat Completions request:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"OUTGOING\", \"/v1/chat/completions\", maskedJSON)\n\t}\n\n\treturn reqBody, nil\n}\n\n// tryFallback attempts to use a fallback provider if the primary fails.\nfunc (h *Handler) tryFallback(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, req *models.AnthropicRequest, resp *http.Response, targetModel string, originalErr error) (*http.Response, string, bool, bool, error) {\n\tfallbackProvider, fallbackModel := h.getFallbackProvider(req.Model)\n\tif fallbackProvider == nil {\n\t\treturn resp, targetModel, false, false, originalErr\n\t}\n\n\t// Close original response if it exists\n\tif resp != nil {\n\t\tresp.Body.Close()\n\t}\n\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.FallbackAttempts, 1)\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Primary provider failed, attempting fallback to %s\", fallbackProvider.Name())\n\n\t// Re-transform request with fallback model if specified\n\tuseResponsesAPI := false\n\tvar reqBody []byte\n\tif fallbackModel != \"\" {\n\t\ttargetModel = fallbackModel\n\t\tfallbackEndpointType := translator.GetEndpointType(fallbackModel)\n\t\tuseResponsesAPI = fallbackEndpointType == translator.EndpointResponses\n\n\t\tif openaiProvider, ok := fallbackProvider.(*provider.OpenAIProvider); ok {\n\t\t\topenaiProvider.SetTargetModel(targetModel)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tvar err error\n\t// Fallback always uses full context (no compaction) for safety.\n\treqBody, err = h.transformRequest(req, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, \"\", 0)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, false, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Try fallback provider\n\tresp, err = h.doRequestWithRetry(ctx, reqBody, fallbackProvider)\n\tif err == nil && resp.StatusCode < 500 {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.FallbackSuccesses, 1)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Fallback to %s succeeded\", fallbackProvider.Name())\n\t\treturn resp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, true, nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn resp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, false, err\n}\n\n// handleUpstreamError handles error responses from the upstream provider.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleUpstreamError(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response) {\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil && resp.StatusCode >= 500 {\n\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t}\n\tbody, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)\n\tmaskedBody := secrets.MaskAllSecrets(string(body))\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Upstream error (%d): %s\", resp.StatusCode, maskedBody)\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\tw.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)\n\t_, _ = w.Write(body)\n}\n\n// handleResponse routes the response to the appropriate handler.\n// sessionKey and messageCount are used for compaction session tracking on Responses API paths.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response, isStreaming, useResponsesAPI bool, targetModel, cacheKey string, cacheable bool, sessionKey string, messageCount int) {\n\tif isStreaming {\n\t\tif useResponsesAPI useResponsesAPI {\n\t\t\th.handleResponsesNonStreamingResponse(w, resp, targetModel, cacheKey, cacheable, sessionKey, messageCount)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.handleNonStreamingResponse(w, resp, targetModel, cacheKey, cacheable)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// checkPromptCache checks if the request can be served from the prompt cache.\n// Returns (\"HIT\", false, 0) if the response was served from cache, otherwise (\"\", false, 0).\n// This is a stub; full implementation is provided by the prompt-cache bead.\nfunc (h *Handler) checkPromptCache(_ http.ResponseWriter, _ *models.AnthropicRequest) (string, bool, int) {\n\treturn \"\", false, 0\n}\n\n// handlePassthroughRequest handles requests that don't require transformation.\n// This is used for direct Anthropic API passthrough where the request is already\n// in the correct format. The _ string and _ int params are reserved for\n// future prompt-cache integration (promptCacheKey, promptCacheTokens).\nfunc (h *Handler) handlePassthroughRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, anthropicReq *models.AnthropicRequest, p provider.Provider, start time.Time, cacheKey string, cacheable bool) {\n\t// Marshal the original Anthropic request\n\treqBody, err := json.Marshal(anthropicReq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error marshaling passthrough request: %v\", err)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, \"api_error\", \"Error preparing request\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Debug logging for passthrough request (secrets are masked)\n\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(reqBody)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Passthrough to Anthropic API:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\t// Also log to dedicated debug file\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"PASSTHROUGH\", \"/v1/messages\", maskedJSON)\n\t}\n\n\t// Execute request with retry logic\n\tresp, err := h.doRequestWithRetry(r.Context(), reqBody, p)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error in passthrough request: %v\", err)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusBadGateway, \"api_error\", \"Error connecting to Anthropic API\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdefer resp.Body.Close()\n\n\t// Check for upstream errors\n\tif resp.StatusCode >= 400 {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil && resp.StatusCode >= 500 {\n\t\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t\t}\n\t\tbody, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)\n\t\t// Mask any secrets in error response before logging\n\t\tmaskedBody := secrets.MaskAllSecrets(string(body))\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Anthropic API error (%d): %s\", resp.StatusCode, maskedBody)\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t\tw.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)\n\t\t_, _ = w.Write(body) // Send original response to client\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Record success for circuit breaker\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordSuccess()\n\t}\n\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.TotalLatencyMs, time.Since(start).Milliseconds())\n\n\t// Add passthrough indicator header\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Passthrough\", \"true\")\n\n\t// Handle streaming vs non-streaming passthrough\n\tif anthropicReq.Stream {\n\t\th.handlePassthroughStreaming(w, resp)\n\t} else {\n\t\th.handlePassthroughNonStreaming(w, resp, cacheKey, cacheable)\n\t}\n}\n\n// handlePassthroughStreaming streams the Anthropic response directly.\nfunc (h *Handler) handlePassthroughStreaming(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response) {\n\t// Set SSE headers\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"text/event-stream\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-cache\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Connection\", \"keep-alive\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-Accel-Buffering\", \"no\")\n\n\t// Flush headers\n\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\tf.Flush()\n\t}\n\n\t// Stream response directly\n\tbuf := make([]byte, 4096)\n\tfor {\n\t\tn, err := resp.Body.Read(buf)\n\t\tif n > 0 {\n\t\t\tif _, writeErr := w.Write(buf[:n]); writeErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error writing passthrough stream: %v\", writeErr)\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\t\t\tf.Flush()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tif err != io.EOF {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error reading passthrough response: %v\", err)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusBadGateway, \"api_error\", \"Error reading upstream \"MISS\")\n\t_, _ = w.Write(body)\n}\n\n// doRequestWithRetry executes the upstream request with exponential backoff retry.\nfunc (h *Handler) doRequestWithRetry(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, reqBody []byte, p provider.Provider) (*http.Response, error) {\n\tmaxRetries := 3\n\tbaseDelay := 500 * time.Millisecond\n\n\tvar lastErr error\n\tfor attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {\n\t\t// Create fresh request for each attempt with context\n\t\tupstreamReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(context.Background(), http.MethodPost, p.GetEndpointURL(), bytes.NewReader(reqBody))\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"creating request: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Set headers (API key may be embedded in provider for tier routing)\n\t\tfor key, values := range p.GetHeaders(h.cfg.GetAPIKey()) {\n\t\t\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\t\t\tupstreamReq.Header.Add(key, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tresp, err := h.client.Do(upstreamReq)\n\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t// Check if we should retry based on status code\n\t\t\tif resp.StatusCode < 500 || resp.StatusCode == 529 { // Don't retry 5xx except overload\n\t\t\t\treturn resp, nil\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// Close response for retry\n\t\t\tresp.Body.Close()\n\t\t\tlastErr = fmt.Errorf(\"upstream returned %d\", resp.StatusCode)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tlastErr = err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Don't retry on last attempt\n\t\tif attempt < maxRetries-1 {\n\t\t\tdelay := baseDelay * time.Duration(1<<attempt) // Exponential backoff\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Retry %d/%d after %v: %v\", attempt+1, maxRetries, delay, lastErr)\n\n\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"context canceled\")\n\t\t\tcase <-time.After(delay):\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"max retries exceeded: %w\", lastErr)\n}\n\n// getFallbackProvider returns the appropriate fallback provider and model for the given request model.\n// It checks tier-specific fallbacks first, then global fallback.\nfunc (h *Handler) getFallbackProvider(requestModel string) (provider.Provider, string) {\n\t// First check for tier-specific fallback\n\ttier := config.GetModelTier(requestModel)\n\tif fbProvider, ok := h.tierFallbacks[tier]; ok {\n\t\t// Get fallback model from tier config\n\t\ttierCfg := h.cfg.GetTierConfig(requestModel)\n\t\tif tierCfg != nil && tierCfg.FallbackModel != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fbProvider, tierCfg.FallbackModel\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fbProvider, \"\"\n\t}\n\n\t// Fall back to global fallback provider\n\tif h.fallbackProvider != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fallbackProvider, h.cfg.FallbackModel\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil, \"\"\n}\n\n// writeErrorResponse writes an Anthropic-formatted errType,\n\t\t\t\"message\": message,\n\t\t},\n\t})\n}\n\n// handleStreamingResponse handles SSE streaming responses.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleStreamingResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, resp \"completed\" {\n\t\tif hasToolCalls {\n\t\t\tanthropicResp.StopReason = \"tool_use\"\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tanthropicResp.StopReason = \"end_turn\"\n\t\t}\n\t} else if responsesResp.Status == \"failed\" {\n\t\tanthropicResp.StopReason = \"end_turn\"\n\t}\n\n\t// Debug logging for Anthropic response (secrets are masked)\n\tif h.cfg.DebugResponses {\n\t\tdebugJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(anthropicResp, \"\", \"  \")\n\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(debugJSON)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Transformed Anthropic response from Responses API:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\t// Also log to dedicated debug file\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"RESPONSE\", \"/v1/messages (from responses)\", maskedJSON)\n\t}\n\n\t// Track costs\n\tif h.costTracker != nil && anthropicResp.Usage != nil {\n\t\th.costTracker.RecordUsage(\n\t\t\th.provider.Name(),\n\t\t\ttargetModel,\n\t\t\tanthropicResp.Usage.InputTokens,\n\t\t\tanthropicResp.Usage.OutputTokens,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\t// Store in cache if cacheable\n\tif h.cache != nil && cacheable && cacheKey != \"\" {\n\t\th.cache.Set(cacheKey, &anthropicResp)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Responses API response cached (key: %s...)\", cacheKey[:16])\n\t\th.tryStorePromptCache(cacheKey, &anthropicResp)\n\t}\n\n\t// Write response\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Cache\", \"MISS\")\n\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(anthropicResp)\n}\n\n// HandleHealth handles health check requests.\nfunc (h *Handler) HandleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\n\tresponse := map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\"status\":   \"healthy\",\n\t\t\"provider\": h.provider.Name(),\n\t\t\"uptime\":   time.Since(h.metrics.StartTime).String(),\n\t}\n\n\t// Add circuit breaker status if enabled\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\tresponse[\"circuit_breaker\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"state\": h.circuitBreaker.State(),\n\t\t\t\"open\":  h.circuitBreaker.IsOpen(),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add provider health details if health checker is enabled\n\tif h.healthChecker != nil {\n\t\tproviderHealth := h.healthChecker.GetHealth()\n\t\tresponse[\"providers\"] = providerHealth\n\n\t\t// Determine overall status based on provider health\n\t\tif !h.healthChecker.IsHealthy() {\n\t\t\tresponse[\"status\"] = \"degraded\"\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add summary\n\t\tstats := h.healthChecker.GetStats()\n\t\tresponse[\"health_summary\"] = stats\n\t}\n\n\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)\n}\n\n// HandleMetrics handles metrics endpoint requests.\nfunc (h *Handler) HandleMetrics(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\ttotal := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.TotalRequests)\n\tsuccess := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests)\n\terrors := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests)\n\tstreams := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.StreamRequests)\n\ttoolCalls := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.ToolCallRequests)\n\ttotalLatency := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.TotalLatencyMs)\n\n\tvar avgLatency float64\n\tif success > 0 {\n\t\tavgLatency = float64(totalLatency) / float64(success)\n\t}\n\n\tuptime := time.Since(h.metrics.StartTime)\n\tvar requestsPerSec float64\n\tif uptime.Seconds() > 0 {\n\t\trequestsPerSec = float64(total) / uptime.Seconds()\n\t}\n\n\tvar successRate float64\n\tif total > 0 {\n\t\tsuccessRate = float64(success) / float64(total) * 100\n\t}\n\n\tresponse := map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\"requests\": map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"total\":        total,\n\t\t\t\"successful\":   success,\n\t\t\t\"errors\":       errors,\n\t\t\t\"streaming\":    streams,\n\t\t\t\"tool_calls\":   toolCalls,\n\t\t\t\"success_rate\": fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f%%\", successRate),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"performance\": map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"avg_latency_ms\":   fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f\", avgLatency),\n\t\t\t\"requests_per_sec\": fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f\", requestsPerSec),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"uptime\":   uptime.String(),\n\t\t\"provider\": h.provider.Name(),\n\t}\n\n\t// Add compaction stats if enabled\n\tif h.sessionTracker != nil {\n\t\tcompHits := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.CompactionHits)\n\t\tcompMisses := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.CompactionMisses)\n\t\tvar compRate float64\n\t\tif total := compHits + compMisses; total > 0 {\n\t\t\tcompRate = float64(compHits) / float64(total) * 100\n\t\t}\n\t\tresponse[\"compaction\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":          true,\n\t\t\t\"hits\":             compHits,\n\t\t\t\"misses\":           compMisses,\n\t\t\t\"hit_rate\":         fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f%%\", compRate),\n\t\t\t\"active_sessions\":  h.sessionTracker.Len(),\n\t\t\t\"session_timeout_s\": h.cfg.SessionTimeoutSec,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add rate limit stats if enabled\n\tif h.rateLimiter != nil {\n\t\tallowed, denied := h.rateLimiter.Stats()\n\t\tresponse[\"rate_limit\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":  true,\n\t\t\t\"allowed\":  allowed,\n\t\t\t\"denied\":   denied,\n\t\t\t\"requests\": h.cfg.RateLimitRequests,\n\t\t\t\"window\":   h.cfg.RateLimitWindow,\n\t\t\t\"burst\":    h.cfg.RateLimitBurst,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add cache stats if enabled\n\tif h.cache != nil {\n\t\tsize, maxSize, hits, misses, hitRate := h.cache.Stats()\n\t\tresponse[\"cache\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":  true,\n\t\t\t\"size\":     size,\n\t\t\t\"max_size\": maxSize,\n\t\t\t\"hits\":     hits,\n\t\t\t\"misses\":   misses,\n\t\t\t\"hit_rate\": fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f%%\", hitRate),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add prompt cache stats if enabled\n\tif h.promptCache != nil {\n\t\tpcStats := h.promptCache.Stats()\n\t\tresponse[\"prompt_cache\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":          true,\n\t\t\t\"size\":             pcStats.Size,\n\t\t\t\"max_size\":         pcStats.MaxSize,\n\t\t\t\"hits\":             pcStats.Hits,\n\t\t\t\"misses\":           pcStats.Misses,\n\t\t\t\"hit_rate\":         fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f%%\", pcStats.HitRate),\n\t\t\t\"savings_tokens\":   pcStats.SavingsTokens,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add fallback stats if fallback is configured\n\tif h.fallbackProvider != nil || len(h.tierFallbacks) > 0 {\n\t\tfbAttempts := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.FallbackAttempts)\n\t\tfbSuccesses := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.FallbackSuccesses)\n\t\tvar fbSuccessRate float64\n\t\tif fbAttempts > 0 {\n\t\t\tfbSuccessRate = float64(fbSuccesses) / float64(fbAttempts) * 100\n\t\t}\n\t\tresponse[\"fallback\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":      true,\n\t\t\t\"attempts\":     fbAttempts,\n\t\t\t\"successes\":    fbSuccesses,\n\t\t\t\"success_rate\": fmt.Sprintf(\"%.2f%%\", fbSuccessRate),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add queue stats if enabled\n\tif h.queue != nil {\n\t\tstats := h.queue.Stats()\n\t\tresponse[\"queue\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":  true,\n\t\t\t\"queued\":   stats.Queued,\n\t\t\t\"dequeued\": stats.Dequeued,\n\t\t\t\"dropped\":  stats.Dropped,\n\t\t\t\"retried\":  stats.Retried,\n\t\t\t\"expired\":  stats.Expired,\n\t\t\t\"length\":   stats.Length,\n\t\t\t\"paused\":   stats.Paused,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add circuit breaker stats if enabled\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\tresponse[\"circuit_breaker\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\": true,\n\t\t\t\"state\":   h.circuitBreaker.State(),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add health check stats if enabled\n\tif h.healthChecker != nil {\n\t\tresponse[\"health_checker\"] = h.healthChecker.GetStats()\n\t\tresponse[\"provider_health\"] = h.healthChecker.GetHealth()\n\t}\n\n\t// Add cost tracking stats\n\tif h.costTracker != nil {\n\t\tsummary := h.costTracker.GetSummary()\n\t\tresponse[\"costs\"] = map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"enabled\":             true,\n\t\t\t\"total_cost_usd\":      fmt.Sprintf(\"%.6f\", summary.TotalCostUSD),\n\t\t\t\"input_cost_usd\":      fmt.Sprintf(\"%.6f\", summary.InputCostUSD),\n\t\t\t\"output_cost_usd\":     fmt.Sprintf(\"%.6f\", summary.OutputCostUSD),\n\t\t\t\"total_input_tokens\":  summary.TotalInputTokens,\n\t\t\t\"total_output_tokens\": summary.TotalOutputTokens,\n\t\t\t\"cost_per_request\":    fmt.Sprintf(\"%.6f\", summary.CostPerRequest),\n\t\t\t\"cost_per_hour\":       fmt.Sprintf(\"%.6f\", summary.CostPerHour),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)\n}\n\n// HandleMetricsPrometheus handles Prometheus metrics endpoint requests.\nfunc (h *Handler) HandleMetricsPrometheus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\ttotal := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.TotalRequests)\n\tsuccess := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests)\n\terrors := atomic.LoadInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests)\n\tstreams := strconv.Atoi(maxSize)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_QUEUE_MAX_SIZE: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.QueueMaxSize = m\n\t}\n\tif maxWait := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT\"); maxWait != \"\" {\n\t\tm, err := strconv.Atoi(maxWait)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.QueueMaxWaitSeconds = m\n\t}\n\tif retryDelay := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_QUEUE_RETRY_DELAY\"); retryDelay != \"\" {\n\t\tr, err := strconv.Atoi(retryDelay)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_QUEUE_RETRY_DELAY: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.QueueRetryDelayMs = r\n\t}\n\tif maxRetries := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_QUEUE_MAX_RETRIES\"); maxRetries != \"\" {\n\t\tm, err := strconv.Atoi(maxRetries)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_QUEUE_MAX_RETRIES: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.QueueMaxRetries = m\n\t}\n\n\t// Model aliasing - load aliases from environment\n\t// Pattern: CLASP_ALIAS_<alias>=<target_model>\n\t// Also supports: CLASP_MODEL_ALIASES=alias1:model1,alias2:model2\n\tcfg.ModelAliases = loadModelAliases()\n\n\t// Circuit breaker settings\n\tcfg.CircuitBreakerEnabled = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER\") == \"true\" || os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER\") == \"1\"\n\tif threshold := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD\"); threshold != \"\" {\n\t\tt, err := strconv.Atoi(threshold)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.CircuitBreakerThreshold = t\n\t}\n\tif recovery := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY\"); recovery != \"\" {\n\t\tr, err := strconv.Atoi(recovery)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.CircuitBreakerRecovery = r\n\t}\n\tif timeout := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TIMEOUT\"); timeout != \"\" {\n\t\tt, err := strconv.Atoi(timeout)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TIMEOUT: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.CircuitBreakerTimeoutSec = t\n\t}\n\n\t// Health checker settings\n\tif healthCheck := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_HEALTH_CHECK\"); healthCheck != \"\" {\n\t\tcfg.HealthCheckEnabled = healthCheck == \"true\" || healthCheck == \"1\"\n\t}\n\tif interval := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL\"); interval != \"\" {\n\t\ti, err := strconv.Atoi(interval)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.HealthCheckIntervalSec = i\n\t}\n\tif timeout := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT\"); timeout != \"\" {\n\t\tt, err := strconv.Atoi(timeout)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.HealthCheckTimeoutSec = t\n\t}\n\n\t// HTTP client settings\n\tif httpTimeout := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_HTTP_TIMEOUT\"); httpTimeout != \"\" {\n\t\tt, err := strconv.Atoi(httpTimeout)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_HTTP_TIMEOUT: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.HTTPClientTimeoutSec = t\n\t}\n\n\t// Compaction settings\n\tcfg.CompactionEnabled = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_COMPACTION\") == \"true\" || os.Getenv(\"CLASP_COMPACTION\") == \"1\"\n\tif sessionTimeout := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_SESSION_TIMEOUT\"); sessionTimeout != \"\" {\n\t\tt, err := strconv.Atoi(sessionTimeout)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"invalid CLASP_SESSION_TIMEOUT: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.SessionTimeoutSec = t\n\t}\n\n\t// Multi-provider routing settings\n\tcfg.MultiProviderEnabled = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_MULTI_PROVIDER\") == \"true\" || os.Getenv(\"CLASP_MULTI_PROVIDER\") == \"1\"\n\tcfg.TierOpus = loadTierConfig(\"OPUS\", cfg)\n\tcfg.TierSonnet = loadTierConfig(\"SONNET\", cfg)\n\tcfg.TierHaiku = loadTierConfig(\"HAIKU\", cfg)\n\n\t// Fallback routing settings\n\tcfg.FallbackEnabled = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_FALLBACK\") == \"true\" || os.Getenv(\"CLASP_FALLBACK\") == \"1\"\n\tif fallbackProvider := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_FALLBACK_PROVIDER\"); fallbackProvider != \"\" {\n\t\tcfg.FallbackProvider = ProviderType(fallbackProvider)\n\t}\n\tcfg.FallbackModel = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_FALLBACK_MODEL\")\n\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_FALLBACK_API_KEY\")\n\tcfg.FallbackBaseURL = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_FALLBACK_BASE_URL\")\n\n\t// Inherit API key from main config if not specified\n\tif cfg.FallbackEnabled && cfg.FallbackAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch cfg.FallbackProvider {\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OpenAIAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\t\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.AzureAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\t\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.AnthropicAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.CustomAPIKey\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Auto-detect provider from available API keys if not explicitly set\n\tif os.Getenv(\"PROVIDER\") == \"\" {\n\t\tcfg.Provider = detectProvider(cfg)\n\t}\n\n\t// Validate configuration\n\tif err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn cfg, nil\n}\n\n// detectProvider determines the provider based on available API keys.\nfunc detectProvider(cfg *Config) ProviderType {\n\tif cfg.OpenAIAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderOpenAI\n\t}\n\tif cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderOpenRouter\n\t}\n\tif cfg.AzureAPIKey != \"\" && cfg.AzureEndpoint != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderAzure\n\t}\n\tif cfg.AnthropicAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderAnthropic\n\t}\n\tif cfg.GeminiAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderGemini\n\t}\n\tif cfg.DeepSeekAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderDeepSeek\n\t}\n\tif cfg.GrokAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderGrok\n\t}\n\tif cfg.QwenAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderQwen\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MiniMaxAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderMiniMax\n\t}\n\t// LiteLLM can work with or without API key, check base URL\n\tif cfg.LiteLLMBaseURL != \"\" && cfg.LiteLLMBaseURL != \"http://localhost:4000\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderLiteLLM\n\t}\n\t// Ollama doesn't require API key, check if base URL is set or use detection\n\tif cfg.OllamaBaseURL != \"\" && cfg.OllamaBaseURL != \"http://localhost:11434\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderOllama\n\t}\n\tif cfg.CustomAPIKey != \"\" && cfg.CustomBaseURL != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderCustom\n\t}\n\treturn ProviderOpenAI // Default\n}\n\n// loadTierConfig loads tier-specific configuration from environment variables.\n// Pattern: CLASP_<TIER>_PROVIDER, CLASP_<TIER>_MODEL, CLASP_<TIER>_API_KEY, CLASP_<TIER>_BASE_URL\n// Fallback: CLASP_<TIER>_FALLBACK_PROVIDER, CLASP_<TIER>_FALLBACK_MODEL, etc.\nfunc loadTierConfig(tier string, cfg *Config) *TierConfig {\n\tprovider := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_PROVIDER\")\n\tmodel := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_MODEL\")\n\tapiKey := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_API_KEY\")\n\tbaseURL := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_BASE_URL\")\n\n\t// If no provider specified for this tier, return nil\n\tif provider == \"\" && model == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\ttierCfg := &TierConfig{\n\t\tProvider: ProviderType(provider),\n\t\tModel:    model,\n\t\tAPIKey:   apiKey,\n\t\tBaseURL:  baseURL,\n\t}\n\n\t// If no explicit API key, inherit from main config based on provider\n\tif tierCfg.APIKey == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch tierCfg.Provider {\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.OpenAIAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.AzureAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.AnthropicAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.OllamaAPIKey // Usually empty\n\t\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.GeminiAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.DeepSeekAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.GrokAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.QwenAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.MiniMaxAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.LiteLLMAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.CustomAPIKey\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// If no explicit base URL, use defaults based on provider\n\tif tierCfg.BaseURL == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch tierCfg.Provider {\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.OpenAIBaseURL\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.OpenRouterBaseURL\n\t\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.OllamaBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.GeminiBaseURL + \"/openai\"\n\t\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.DeepSeekBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.GrokBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.QwenBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.MiniMaxBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.LiteLLMBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.CustomBaseURL\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Load tier-specific fallback configuration\n\tfallbackProvider := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_PROVIDER\")\n\tif fallbackProvider != \"\" {\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackProvider = ProviderType(fallbackProvider)\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackModel = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_MODEL\")\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_API_KEY\")\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackBaseURL = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_BASE_URL\")\n\n\t\t// Inherit fallback API key if not specified\n\t\tif tierCfg.FallbackAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\tswitch tierCfg.FallbackProvider {\n\t\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OpenAIAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.AzureAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.AnthropicAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OllamaAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.GeminiAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.DeepSeekAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.GrokAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.QwenAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.MiniMaxAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.CustomAPIKey\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn tierCfg\n}\n\n// Validate checks that the configuration is valid.\nfunc (c *Config) Validate() error {\n\tswitch c.Provider {\n\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\tif c.OpenAIAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"OPENAI_API_KEY is required for provider 'openai'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\tif c.AzureAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"AZURE_API_KEY is required for provider 'azure'\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.AzureEndpoint == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT is required for provider 'azure'\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.AzureDeploymentName == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_NAME is required for provider 'azure'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\tif c.OpenRouterAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY is required for provider 'openrouter'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\tif c.AnthropicAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is required for provider 'anthropic'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t// Ollama doesn't require API key - it runs locally\n\t\t// Base URL defaults to http://localhost:11434\n\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\tif c.GeminiAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"GEMINI_API_KEY is required for provider 'gemini'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\tif c.DeepSeekAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is required for provider 'deepseek'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\tif c.GrokAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"GROK_API_KEY is required for provider 'grok'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\tif c.QwenAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"QWEN_API_KEY is required for provider 'qwen'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\tif c.MiniMaxAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"MINIMAX_API_KEY is required for provider 'minimax'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\t// LiteLLM base URL is required, but API key is optional (depends on LiteLLM server config)\n\t\tif c.LiteLLMBaseURL == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"LITELLM_BASE_URL is required for provider 'litellm'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\tif c.CustomBaseURL == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"CUSTOM_BASE_URL is required for provider 'custom'\")\n\t\t}\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"unknown provider: %s\", c.Provider)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// GetAPIKey returns the API key for the configured provider.\nfunc (c *Config) GetAPIKey() string {\n\tswitch c.Provider {\n\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\treturn c.OpenAIAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\treturn c.AzureAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\treturn c.OpenRouterAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\treturn c.AnthropicAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\treturn c.OllamaAPIKey // Usually empty for local Ollama\n\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\treturn c.GeminiAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\treturn c.DeepSeekAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\treturn c.GrokAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\treturn c.QwenAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\treturn c.MiniMaxAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\treturn c.LiteLLMAPIKey\n\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\treturn c.CustomAPIKey\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// GetBaseURL returns the base URL for the configured provider.\nfunc (c *Config) GetBaseURL() string {\n\tswitch c.Provider {\n\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\treturn c.OpenAIBaseURL\n\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/openai/deployments/%s\", c.AzureEndpoint, c.AzureDeploymentName)\n\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\treturn c.OpenRouterBaseURL\n\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\treturn \"https://api.anthropic.com\"\n\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t// Ollama exposes OpenAI-compatible API at /v1\n\t\treturn c.OllamaBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t// Gemini uses OpenAI-compatible endpoint at /v1beta/openai\n\t\treturn c.GeminiBaseURL + \"/openai\"\n\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t// DeepSeek uses standard OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint\n\t\treturn c.DeepSeekBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t// Grok uses standard OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint\n\t\treturn c.GrokBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t// Qwen uses OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint via DashScope\n\t\treturn c.QwenBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t// MiniMax uses standard OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint\n\t\treturn c.MiniMaxBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\t// LiteLLM exposes OpenAI-compatible API at /v1\n\t\treturn c.LiteLLMBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\treturn c.CustomBaseURL\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// GetChatCompletionsURL returns the full URL for chat completions.\nfunc (c *Config) GetChatCompletionsURL() string {\n\tswitch c.Provider {\n\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/chat/completions?api-version=%s\", c.GetBaseURL(), c.AzureAPIVersion)\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn c.GetBaseURL() + \"/chat/completions\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// MapModel applies model mapping based on the requested model.\nfunc (c *Config) MapModel(requestedModel string) string {\n\t// Check for tier-based mapping\n\tswitch {\n\tcase contains(requestedModel, \"opus\") && c.ModelOpus != \"\":\n\t\treturn c.ModelOpus\n\tcase contains(requestedModel, \"sonnet\") && c.ModelSonnet != \"\":\n\t\treturn c.ModelSonnet\n\tcase contains(requestedModel, \"haiku\") && c.ModelHaiku != \"\":\n\t\treturn c.ModelHaiku\n\t}\n\n\t// Return default model if set, otherwise use requested model\n\tif c.DefaultModel != \"\" {\n\t\treturn c.DefaultModel\n\t}\n\treturn requestedModel\n}\n\n// GetTierConfig returns the tier-specific configuration for a given model.\n// Returns nil if multi-provider routing is disabled or no tier config exists.\nfunc (c *Config) GetTierConfig(requestedModel string) *TierConfig {\n\tif !c.MultiProviderEnabled {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Match model to tier\n\tswitch {\n\tcase contains(requestedModel, \"opus\"):\n\t\treturn c.TierOpus\n\tcase contains(requestedModel, \"sonnet\"):\n\t\treturn c.TierSonnet\n\tcase contains(requestedModel, \"haiku\"):\n\t\treturn c.TierHaiku\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// HasFallback checks if the tier config has a fallback provider configured.\nfunc (tc *TierConfig) HasFallback() bool {\n\treturn tc != nil && tc.FallbackProvider != \"\"\n}\n\n// GetFallbackConfig returns a new TierConfig representing the fallback.\nfunc (tc *TierConfig) GetFallbackConfig() *TierConfig {\n\tif tc == nil || tc.FallbackProvider == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\treturn &TierConfig{\n\t\tProvider: tc.FallbackProvider,\n\t\tModel:    tc.FallbackModel,\n\t\tAPIKey:   tc.FallbackAPIKey,\n\t\tBaseURL:  tc.FallbackBaseURL,\n\t}\n}\n\n// HasGlobalFallback checks if global fallback is configured.\nfunc (c *Config) HasGlobalFallback() bool {\n\treturn c.FallbackEnabled && c.FallbackProvider != \"\"\n}\n\n// GetGlobalFallbackConfig returns a TierConfig for the global fallback.\nfunc (c *Config) GetGlobalFallbackConfig() *TierConfig {\n\tif !c.HasGlobalFallback() {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tbaseURL := c.FallbackBaseURL\n\tif baseURL == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch c.FallbackProvider {\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\tbaseURL = c.OpenAIBaseURL\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\tbaseURL = c.OpenRouterBaseURL\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\tbaseURL = c.CustomBaseURL\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn &TierConfig{\n\t\tProvider: c.FallbackProvider,\n\t\tModel:    c.FallbackModel,\n\t\tAPIKey:   c.FallbackAPIKey,\n\t\tBaseURL:  baseURL,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ModelTier represents a Claude model tier.\ntype ModelTier string\n\nconst (\n\tTierOpus   ModelTier = \"opus\"\n\tTierSonnet ModelTier = \"sonnet\"\n\tTierHaiku  ModelTier = \"haiku\"\n)\n\n// GetModelTier returns the tier for a given model name.\nfunc GetModelTier(model string) ModelTier {\n\tswitch {\n\tcase contains(model, \"opus\"):\n\t\treturn TierOpus\n\tcase contains(model, \"sonnet\"):\n\t\treturn TierSonnet\n\tcase contains(model, \"haiku\"):\n\t\treturn TierHaiku\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn TierSonnet // Default to sonnet tier\n\t}\n}\n\n// contains checks if s contains substr (case-insensitive).\nfunc contains(s, substr string) bool {\n\treturn len(s) >= len(substr) &&\n\t\t(s == substr ||\n\t\t\tlen(s) > len(substr) &&\n\t\t\t\t(s[:len(substr)] == substr ||\n\t\t\t\t\ts[len(s)-len(substr):] == substr ||\n\t\t\t\t\tcontainsMiddle(s, substr)))\n}\n\nfunc containsMiddle(s, substr string) bool {\n\tfor i := 1; i <= len(s)-len(substr); i++ {\n\t\tif NewModelPicker(models []ModelInfo, provider, tier string) *ModelPicker {\n106\t\t// Create text input for filtering\n107\t\tti := textinput.New()\n108\t\tti.Placeholder = \"Type to filter...\"\n109\t\tti.Focus()\n110\t\tti.PromptStyle = filterPromptStyle\n111\t\tti.CharLimit = 50\n112\t\tti.Width = 40\n113\t\n114\t\t// Create list with custom delegate\n115\t\tdelegate := list.NewDefaultDelegate()\n116\t\tdelegate.ShowDescription = true\n117\t\tdelegate.SetSpacing(0)\n118\t\n119\t\t// Convert to list items\n120\t\titems := make([]list.Item, len(models))\n121\t\tfor i, m := range models {\n122\t\t\titems[i] = m\n123\t\t}\n124\t\n125\t\tl := list.New(items, delegate, 0, 0)\n126\t\t// Don't show the list's title - we render our own\n127\t\tl.SetShowTitle(false)\n128\t\t// Don't show the list's filter - we have our own visible filter input\n129\t\tl.SetFilteringEnabled(false)\n130\t\tl.SetShowStatusBar(false)\n131\t\tl.SetShowPagination(true)\n132\t\tl.SetShowHelp(false) // We show our own help\n133\t\tl.DisableQuitKeybindings()\n134\t\n135\t\t// Set styles\n136\t\tl.Styles.PaginationStyle = paginationStyle\n137\t\n138\t\treturn &ModelPicker{\n139\t\t\tlist:        l,\n140\t\t\tfilterInput: ti,\n141\t\t\tmodels:      models,\n142\t\t\tfiltered:    models,\n143\t\t\tprovider:    provider,\n144\t\t\ttier:        tier,\n145\t\t\twidth:       80,\n146\t\t\theight:      20,\n147\t\t}\n148\t}\n149\t\n150\t// Init initializes the model picker.\n151\tfunc (m *ModelPicker) Init() tea.Cmd {\n152\t\treturn nil\n153\t}\n154\t\n155\t// Update handles input and updates the model picker state.\n156\tfunc (m *ModelPicker) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {\n157\t\tswitch msg := msg.(type) {\n158\t\tcase tea.WindowSizeMsg:\n159\t\t\tm.width = msg.Width\n160\t\t\tm.height = msg.Height\n161\t\t\tm.list.SetSize(msg.Width, msg.Height-4) // Leave room for filter input\n162\t\t\treturn m, nil\n163\t\n164\t\tcase tea.KeyMsg:\n165\t\t\tswitch msg.String() {\n166\t\t\tcase \"ctrl+c\":\n167\t\t\t\tm.canceled = true\n168\t\t\t\treturn m, tea.Quit\n169\t\n170\t\t\tcase \"q\":\n171\t\t\t\t// Only quit on 'q' if filter is empty (not actively typing)\n172\t\t\t\tif m.filterInput.Value() == \"\" {\n173\t\t\t\t\tm.canceled = true\n174\t\t\t\t\treturn m, tea.Quit\n175\t\t\t\t}\n176\t\t\t\t// Otherwise, 'q' is typed into the filter\n177\t\n178\t\t\tcase \"enter\":\n179\t\t\t\tif item, ok := m.list.SelectedItem().(ModelInfo); ok {\n180\t\t\t\t\tm.selected = &item\n181\t\t\t\t\treturn m, tea.Quit\n182\t\t\t\t}\n183\t\n184\t\t\tcase \"?\":\n185\t\t\t\tm.showHelp = !m.showHelp\n186\t\t\t\treturn m, nil\n187\t\n188\t\t\tcase \"esc\":\n189\t\t\t\tif m.filterInput.Value() != \"\" {\n190\t\t\t\t\tm.filterInput.SetValue(\"\")\n191\t\t\t\t\tm.applyFilter(\"\")\n192\t\t\t\t\treturn m, nil\n193\t\t\t\t}\n194\t\t\t\tm.canceled = true\n195\t\t\t\treturn m, tea.Quit\n196\t\t\t}\n197\t\t}\n198\t\n199\t\t// Update filter input\n200\t\tvar cmd tea.Cmd\n201\t\tm.filterInput, cmd = m.filterInput.Update(msg)\n202\t\n203\t\t// Apply filter if changed\n204\t\tcurrentFilter := m.filterInput.Value()\n205\t\tif currentFilter != m.lastFilterText {\n206\t\t\tm.applyFilter(currentFilter)\n207\t\t\tm.lastFilterText = currentFilter\n208\t\t}\n209\t\n210\t\t// Update list (for navigation)\n211\t\tvar listCmd tea.Cmd\n212\t\tm.list, listCmd = m.list.Update(msg)\n213\t\n214\t\treturn m, tea.Batch(cmd, listCmd)\n215\t}\n216\t\n217\t// applyFilter filters the model list using fuzzy matching.\n218\tfunc (m *ModelPicker) applyFilter(filter string) {\n219\t\tif filter == \"\" {\n220\t\t\t// Reset to all models\n221\t\t\titems := make([]list.Item, len(m.models))\n222\t\t\tfor i, model := range m.models {\n223\t\t\t\titems[i] = model\n224\t\t\t}\n225\t\t\tm.list.SetItems(items)\n226\t\t\tm.filtered = m.models\n227\t\t\treturn\n228\t\t}\n229\t\n230\t\t// Fuzzy match against model IDs and names\n231\t\tsources := make([]string, 0, len(m.models))\n232\t\tfor _, model := range m.models {\n233\t\t\tsources = append(sources, model.ID+\" \"+model.Name+\" \"+model.Desc)\n234\t\t}\n235\t\n236\t\tmatches := fuzzy.Find(filter, sources)\n237\t\n238\t\t// Sort by score\n239\t\tsort.Slice(matches, func(i, j int) bool {\n240\t\t\treturn matches[i].Score > matches[j].Score\n241\t\t})\n242\t\n243\t\t// Build filtered list\n244\t\tfiltered := make([]ModelInfo, 0, len(matches))\n245\t\tfor _, match := range matches {\n246\t\t\tfiltered = append(filtered, m.models[match.Index])\n247\t\t}\n248\t\n249\t\titems := make([]list.Item, len(filtered))\n250\t\tfor i, model := range filtered {\n251\t\t\titems[i] = model\n252\t\t}\n253\t\tm.list.SetItems(items)\n254\t\tm.filtered = filtered\n255\t}\n256\t\n257\t// View renders the model picker with visible filter input.\n258\tfunc (m *ModelPicker) View() string {\n259\t\tif m.err != nil {\n260\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Error: %v\\n\", m.err)\n261\t\t}\n262\t\n263\t\tvar b strings.Builder\n264\t\n265\t\t// m.tier)\n270\t\t}\n271\t\tb.WriteString(titleStyle.Render(title))\n272\t\tb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")\n273\t\n274\t\t// Visible filter input line with cursor\n275\t\tfilterText := != \"\" {\n307\t\t\tif showingCount == 0 {\n308\t\t\t\tb.WriteString(countStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\"No models match '%s'  •  Press Esc to clear filter\", filterText)))\n309\t\t\t} else {\n313\t\t\tb.WriteString(countStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\"Showing %d models  •  Type to filter\", totalCount)))\n314\t\t}\n315\t\tb.WriteString(\"\\n\")\n316\t\n317\t\t// Help section\n318\t\tif fetchModels(provider, apiKey, baseURL, azureEndpoint string) ([]string, error) {\n\tvar url string\n\tvar headers map[string]string\n\n\tswitch provider {\n\tcase \"openai\":\n\t\turl = the Responses API\n// (GPT-5, codex). CLASP handles endpoint routing automatically.\nfunc isChatModel(id string) bool {\n\t// Include GPT models (gpt-3.5, gpt-4, gpt-4o, gpt-4.5, gpt-5, gpt-5.1, etc.)\n\tif strings.HasPrefix(id, \"gpt-\") {\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\t// Include o1 reasoning models\n\tif strings.HasPrefix(id, \"o1\") {\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\t// Include o3 reasoning models\n\tif strings.HasPrefix(id, \"o3\") {\n\tbaseURL = strings.TrimSuffix(baseURL, \"/v1\")\n\tbaseURL = strings.TrimSuffix(baseURL, \"/\")\n\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)\n\tdefer    ║\")\n\tw.println(\"╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\")\n\tw.println(\"\")\n\n\t// Get profile name if not provided\n\tif profileName == \"\" {\n\t\tvar err
